records_needed: Exact terrain and RX mesh vertices, triangle indices and all coordinate transforms used for each selected sample
Actual TX three-dimensional coordinates and antenna configuration before integer-index export
Per-seed pre-interpolation cell_centers, path_gain, triangle IDs and validity; exact seeds and averaging/stopping schedule

tests.name: Export replay
tests.hold_fixed: Recorded original powers, mesh and TX
tests.change: Reproduce only the official export steps
tests.decision: A discrepancy beyond final dtype quantization identifies an export/alignment problem, not an ML fitting problem.

tests.name: Independent-seed variation
tests.hold_fixed: Actual mesh, TX, frequency and fixed sampling budget
tests.change: Use genuinely independent already-recorded seed groups, applying exactly the same export and common validity mask
tests.decision: Measures seed variation. Identical or shared seed schedules must not be used as independent noise replicates.

tests.name: Published-input ambiguity
tests.hold_fixed: Exactly identical released H and TX
tests.change: Compare original physical states only where different states actually occur under the real generator
tests.decision: If Y differs materially beyond seed/export uncertainty for identical published inputs, omitted case-specific physics is demonstrated. Hypothetical alternate meshes outside the real generator do not establish this.

tests.name: Representation versus raw-data sufficiency
tests.hold_fixed: Same terrain-disjoint splits, target maps, learner budget and inference information rule
tests.change: Compare current descriptors, descriptors reconstructed from H using verified generator rules, and actual original-state descriptors
tests.decision: Gains from reconstructible descriptors show representation/model insufficiency. Gains from actual-state descriptors alone identify useful omitted information, but require checking whether those states are deterministically reconstructible from H before calling it fundamental information loss.
